Blockaid Reveals How Hacker Took Control of Binance Wallet: One of 50 EIP-7702 Authorizations Succeeded

According to analysis by blockchain security firm Blockaid, the attacker used Ethereum’s EIP-7702 authorization mechanism to attack Binance’s Binance 14 hot wallet.
